title: The Inheritance of Judah

questions.question: What was the southern boundary of Judah?
options: From the end of the Salt Sea... southward to Kadesh-barnea
questions.correctAnswer: From the end of the Salt Sea... southward to Kadesh-barnea
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:2-3 describes the southern boundary ending at Kadesh-barnea.

questions.question: What did Caleb offer to the man who captured Kiriath-sepher?
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:16 (ESV): "And Caleb said, 'Whoever strikes Kiriath-sepher... to him will I give Achsah my daughter as wife.'"

questions.question: Who captured Kiriath-sepher?
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:17 (ESV): "And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, captured it..."

questions.question: What additional gift did Achsah ask for?
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:19 (ESV): "...give me also springs of water..."

questions.question: Who inhabited Jerusalem that the men of Judah could not drive out?
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:63 (ESV): "But the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the people of Judah could not drive out..."

questions.question: What are the three sons of Anak that Caleb drove out?
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:14 (ESV): "And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak, Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai..."

questions.question: Debir was formerly known by what name?
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:15 (ESV): "...Now the name of Debir formerly was Kiriath-sepher."

questions.question: Along with the springs of water, what specific types of springs did Caleb give Achsah?
options: The upper springs and the lower springs
questions.correctAnswer: The upper springs and the lower springs
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:19 (ESV): "So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs."

questions.question: Where did the Jebusites live in relation to the people of Judah?
options: They dwell with the people of Judah at Jerusalem to this day
questions.correctAnswer: They dwell with the people of Judah at Jerusalem to this day
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:63 (ESV): "so the Jebusites dwell with the people of Judah at Jerusalem to this day."

questions.question: What was the western boundary of Judah?
options: The Great Sea and its coastline
questions.correctAnswer: The Great Sea and its coastline
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:12 (ESV): "And the west boundary was the Great Sea with its coastline."

questions.question: How many cities with their villages were in the first district in the Negeb mentioned?
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:32 (ESV): "in all, twenty-nine cities with their villages."

questions.question: Which Philistine cities are mentioned as part of Judah's inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:45-47 lists Ekron, Ashdod, and Gaza.

questions.question: The Valley of Hinnom is associated with which city?
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:8 (ESV): "Then the boundary goes up by the Valley of the Son of Hinnom at the southern shoulder of the Jebusite (that is, Jerusalem)..."

questions.question: Who was Othniel related to Caleb?
options: Son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb
questions.correctAnswer: Son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:17 (ESV): "...Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb..."

questions.question: Did Judah drive out all inhabitants?
options: No, they could not drive out the Jebusites
questions.correctAnswer: No, they could not drive out the Jebusites
questions.explanation: Joshua 15:63 (ESV): "But the Jebusites... the people of Judah could not drive out..."

key_verse_text: But the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the people of Judah could not drive out, so the Jebusites dwell with the people of Judah at Jerusalem to this day. (ESV)
